services.name: Spotify
services.detail: A standalone password can usually be set before disconnecting Facebook.
steps: Open Spotify account settings and set or change your password.
Confirm your email address and test email/password sign-in in a private window.
Disconnect Facebook under the social or connected accounts settings.

services.name: Airbnb
services.detail: Review Login & Security and verify email, phone, and password before unlinking.
steps: Verify your email and phone number, then add a standalone password.
Test the new login before disconnecting Facebook under Social accounts.

services.name: Facebook Marketplace
services.detail: Listings, ratings, and Marketplace history are tied to Facebook and have no migration path.
steps: Export or screenshot active listings and important transaction details.
Save contact information for buyers or sellers you still need to reach.
Treat this service as unavailable after Facebook deletion.
